We are here to help your child reach their developmental milestones one step at a time.

Here at Kids At Play, we strive to assist your child with a plethora of different services. We are based in Philadelphia, with a strong focus on the development of your child. Our mission is to provide your child with exceptional care while paying close attention to his or her individual needs.

Every child at Kids At Play receives quality personalized and individualized care with proven developmental benefits. Our services include speech therapy, occupational therapy, physical therapy and more. In order to help your child reach their full potential, we have composed a staff of the top experts in our industry. Our goal is to produce results, and we can’t wait to help your child achieve success.
